title: Feature Extraction on Tiny Dataset
description: Train only the new classifier on a small synthetic image dataset using a frozen ResNet18.
problemStatement:
Write code that:
1. Creates a synthetic image dataset: 100 samples of 3×224×224 random tensors, with random labels from 0 to 4 (5 classes). Wrap in TensorDataset and DataLoader (batch_size=10).
2. Loads a pretrained ResNet18 (as in task1) and freezes all but a new fc for 5 classes.
3. Trains for 20 epochs using CrossEntropyLoss and SGD with lr=0.01 (only on fc params).
4. Prints the final training accuracy (as percentage with one decimal) in the format "Accuracy: XX.X%".

The output must be exactly that string (accuracy may vary but will be around 20% initially, but with random data it may stay around 20%; that's fine, just check format).
hints: Train only model.fc.parameters() (or pass them to optimizer).
solutionCode:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import torchvision.models as models

torch.manual_seed(0)
# Synthetic data
X = torch.randn(100, 3, 224, 224)
y = torch.randint(0, 5, (100,))
ds = TensorDataset(X, y)
loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=10, shuffle=True)

model = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
model.fc = nn.Linear(model.fc.in_features, 5)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.fc.parameters(), lr=0.01)

model.train()
for epoch in range(20):
    for xb, yb in loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        out = model(xb)
        loss = criterion(out, yb)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    preds = model(X).argmax(dim=1)
    acc = (preds == y).float().mean().item() * 100
print(f"Accuracy: {acc:.1f}%")
